digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework and routing seam
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is hardcoded to Anthropic-shaped behavior with inline provider detection via string prefix matching (runner.py:268, :316, :653), preventing first-class Bedrock and documented base_url/api_key composition from working
AWS Bedrock-hosted Anthropic Claude is unavailable as a native provider; only proxy-gateway approaches exist, losing prompt caching, retrying transport, and structured output fidelity
output mode selection and prompt caching are driven by hardcoded provider-name strings and a static allowlist rather than by reading per-model capability profiles from pydantic-ai

the signed verdict sidecar records only a provider/model string, not structured provenance (provider, endpoint, tier, capabilities), so consumers cannot distinguish first-class from best-effort implementations
pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile override mechanism exist but are unused, leaving a documented seam unimplemented while rebar patches provider behavior via string matching
